notes: Two corrections: the topicalizing 'for' before the fronted אֲרֻחָתוֹ is added under rule 16 (no marker or preposition stands on the phrase); and 'there was … given' is the finite נִתְּנָה's own presentative recasting (rule 17), not a verbless-clause copula on the appositional noun, which keeps only 'a allowance'.
